Title: 1. Kramer vs. Kramer
description: After his wife leaves him, a work-obsessed Manhattan advertising executive is forced to learn long-neglected parenting skills, but a heated custody battle over the couple's young son deepens the wounds left by the separation.

Title: 2. Apocalypse Now
description: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

Title: 3. The Amityville Horror
description: A family moves into a bargain waterfront home linked to mass murder, only to face escalating supernatural disturbances that strain their marriage, threaten their children, and draw desperate intervention from increasingly powerless clergy.

Title: 4. Rocky II
description: Rocky struggles in family life after his bout with Apollo Creed, while the embarrassed champ insistently goads him to accept a challenge for a rematch.

Title: 5. Alien
description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

Title: 6. Star Trek: The Motion Picture
description: When an alien spacecraft of enormous power is spotted approaching Earth, Admiral James T. Kirk resumes command of the overhauled USS Enterprise in order to intercept it.
A Hollywood composer endures a mid-life crisis and becomes infatuated with a newly married woman honeymooning at a Mexican resort.

Title: 8. The Jerk
description: A simpleminded, sheltered country boy suddenly decides to leave his family home to experience life in the big city, where his naivete is both his best friend and his worst enemy.

Title: 9. Moonraker
description: James Bond investigates the mid-air theft of a space shuttle, and discovers a plot to commit global genocide.

Title: 10. The Muppet Movie
description: Kermit and his newfound friends trek across America to find success in Hollywood, but a frog legs merchant is after Kermit.

Title: 11. The Electric Horseman
description: A rodeo star past his prime steals his company's horse and rides into the desert, accompanied by a feisty reporter.

Title: 12. The China Syndrome
description: A reporter finds what appears to be a cover-up of safety hazards at a nuclear power plant.

Title: 13. Love at First Bite
description: After being evicted from his castle in Transylvania, Count Dracula and his assistant Renfield travel to New York to find a woman who the Count believes is the reincarnation of the woman he has loved for all eternity.

Title: 14. Meatballs
description: Another summer descends upon North Star summer camp, and care-free counselor Tripper leads the mediocre and mismanaged campers against their arch rivals at the very well run and expensive neighboring camp, Mohawk.

Title: 15. Escape from Alcatraz
description: Three convicts make a daring escape from the notorious Alcatraz prison in a bid to cross San Francisco Bay in a makeshift raft to Angel Island.

Title: 16. The Main Event
description: A bankrupt entrepreneur attempts to recoup some of her losses by getting a washed-out boxer she picked up as a tax loss back into the ring - an idea her protégé isn't fond of.

Title: 17. Manhattan
description: The life of a divorced television writer dating a teenage girl is further complicated when he falls in love with his best friend's mistress.

Title: 18. All That Jazz
description: Director/choreographer Bob Fosse tells his own life story as he details the sordid career of Joe Gideon, a womanizing, drug-using dancer.

Title: 19. The Black Stallion
description: After being shipwrecked with a magnificent horse off the coast of Africa in the 1940s, a boy bonds with the stallion, and trains him to race after their rescue.

Title: 20. The Black Hole
description: A research vessel finds a missing ship, commanded by a mysterious scientist, on the edge of a black hole.

Title: 21. Starting Over
description: A divorced man falls in love again, but somehow he can't get over his ex-wife.

Title: 22. And Justice for All
description: When a lawyer is forced to defend a judge he despises, his professional and personal lives start to unravel.
Hysterical Californians prepare for a Japanese invasion in the days after Pearl Harbor.

Title: 24. The Champ
description: Billy Flynn is an ex-champion boxer who was KO'd by booze and gambling. When the wealthy, estranged mother of his young son begins trying to lure the boy away from him, Flynn must return to the ring to provide for his child.

Title: 25. Being There
description: After the death of his employer forces him out of the only home he's ever known, a simpleminded, sheltered gardener becomes an unlikely trusted advisor to a powerful tycoon and an insider in Washington politics.

Title: 26. The Rose
description: The tragic life of a self-destructive female rock star who struggles to deal with the constant pressures of her career and the demands of her ruthless business manager.

Title: 27. Going in Style
description: Three friends living on welfare decide to rob a bank.

Title: 28. North Dallas Forty
description: A satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family are bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches.

Title: 29. The Warriors
description: Members of a street gang known as the Warriors must fight their way from the Bronx to their home turf on Coney Island when they are falsely accused of assassinating a respected gang leader.

Title: 30. Norma Rae
description: A young single mother and textile worker agrees to help unionize her mill despite the problems and dangers involved.

Title: 31. Buck Rogers in the 25th Century
description: 20th century astronaut Buck Rogers emerges out of 500 years of suspended animation into the 25th century where Earth is nearly devastated by nuclear warfare and now threatened by alien invaders.

Title: 32. When a Stranger Calls
description: A police detective and a babysitter relive horror years later.

Title: 33. The Apple Dumpling Gang Rides Again
description: The adventures of two idiotic outlaw wannabees, Amos and Theodore.

Title: 34. Monty Python's Life of Brian
description: Born on the original Christmas day in the stable next door to Jesus Christ, Brian of Nazareth spends his life being mistaken for the messiah.

Title: 35. Dracula
description: In 1913, the charming, seductive and sinister vampire Count Dracula travels to England in search of an immortal bride.

Title: 36. Tess
description: A strong-willed young peasant girl attracts the affection of two men.

Title: 37. The Seduction of Joe Tynan
description: A Senator leads opposition to a Supreme Court nominee, straining friendships and family ties while pursuing career advancement. His relationship with a researcher adds further complications.

Title: 38. Prophecy
description: A government health inspector is dispatched to assess the damage a logging company is causing to a patch of forest claimed by Native Americans, and comes face to face with true terror wreaking havoc in the woods.

Title: 39. Breaking Away
description: A working-class Indiana teen obsessed with the Italian cycling team vies for the affections of a college girl while searching for life goals with his friends.

Title: 40. Hair
description: Claude Bukowski leaves the family ranch in Oklahoma for New York where he is rapidly embraced into the hippie group of youngsters led by Berger, yet he's already been drafted. He soon falls in love with Sheila Franklin, a rich girl but still a rebel inside.

Title: 41. More American Graffiti
description: Told in four different New Year's Eves in the mid 1960s, John, Terry, Debbie, Steve and Laurie deal with adulthood, the Vietnam war, peace rallies, and relationships.

Title: 42. Roller Boogie
description: Skaters band together to keep their roller-disco open.

Title: 43. The Concorde... Airport '79
description: A supersonic airborne disaster. In order to survive a flight headed for the Moscow Olympics, passengers of the Concorde must endure aerial acrobatics to dodge missiles and survive a device that decompresses the plane.

Title: 44. Phantasm
description: Newly orphaned teenager Mike Pearson, his older brother Jody, and their friends face off against a mysterious grave robber known as the Tall Man, who employs a lethal arsenal of unearthly weapons in their southern California town.

Title: 45. The Promise
description: A wealthy man's mother manipulates events to separate him from his poor girlfriend.

Title: 46. The Onion Field
description: LA cop Ian Campbell is killed in the onion fields outside of Bakersfield. But legal loopholes could keep his kidnappers Greg Powell and Jimmy Smith from receiving justice, and his partner Karl Hettinger is haunted by survivor's guilt.

Title: 47. The Frisco Kid
description: A Polish rabbi wanders through the Old West on his way to lead a synagogue in San Francisco. On the way, he is nearly burned at the stake by Native Americans and almost killed by outlaws.

Title: 48. Mad Max
description: In a self-destructing world, a vengeful Australian policeman sets out to stop a violent motorcycle gang.

Title: 49. Meteor
description: The U.S. must join forces with the U.S.S.R. in order to destroy a gigantic asteroid heading straight for Earth.

Title: 50. The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh
description: The Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania basketball team is hopeless. Could they become winners with help from an astrologer and some new astrologically-compatible players?

Title: 51. Bloodline
description: When her father dies during a climbing accident, his daughter becomes the head of a pharmaceutical company. With mounting pressure from her relatives to take the company public, it's discovered that her father's death was in fact a murder.

Title: 52. The Prisoner of Zenda
description: In order to save King Rudolph of Ruritania from assassins and murderous usurpers, the kingdom hires a look-a-like London cabby to impersonate the Monarch.

Title: 53. Agatha
description: In December 1926, mystery writer Dame Agatha Christie's husband Colonel Archie Christie asks for a divorce. She leaves her car and goes missing for eleven days. US reporter Wally Stanton searches for her in this speculative story.

Title: 54. Americathon
description: In a story told in narrative flashbacks, young TV consultant Eric McMerkin is hired by President Chet Roosevelt of a bankrupt USA to organize a telethon in order to prevent the country from being repossessed by wealthy Native Americans.

Title: 55. Running
description: American marathon runner Michael Andropolis sets his heart on representing his country at the Olympic games. Meanwhile his marriage has fallen apart and his children have no respect for him. He sets out on his task with determination and hope that his success will resolve his personal problems.

Title: 56. Cuba
description: A British mercenary arrives in pre-Revolution Cuba to help train General Batista's Army against Castro's guerrillas while he also romances a former lover now married to an unscrupulous plantation owner.

Title: 57. Butch and Sundance: The Early Days
description: A prequel of sorts to Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969) which chronicles the two outlaws' lives in the years before the events portrayed in the 1969 movie.

Title: 58. Players
description: A rising tennis star falls for an older woman engaged with a wealthy man she doesn't love. Will he become the next John McEnroe? Will she choose love over financial security?

Title: 59. The Great Santini
description: As he approaches manhood, Ben Meechum struggles to win the approval of his demanding alpha male father, an aggressively competitive, but frustrated Marine pilot.

Title: 60. Yanks
description: Joining WWII, USA ships soldiers to UK. Matt and John arrive in 1942. Each see a local woman - married or to be engaged with soldiers serving faraway.

Title: 61. Guyana: Cult of the Damned
description: Reverend Jim Jones, the priest of an independent church in the South American country Guyana, orders his followers to commit suicide. But not all of them follow him blindly and begin to think on their own.

Title: 62. Lost and Found
description: An American widower and a British divorcée keep running into each other and marry. But when the marriage loses its bloom, they try to separate, yet can’t stop finding their way back together.

Title: 63. Hanover Street
description: Margaret is a nurse in England during WW2, and married to a secret agent. Things get complicated when she falls for David, an American pilot.

Title: 64. Voices
description: A young man meets a deaf teacher and finds she is a great dancer. He encourages her to follow her dream of becoming a professional dancer.

Title: 65. Wanda Nevada
description: A drifter named Beaudray Demerille wins a young orphan named Wanda in a poker game and takes her gold prospecting in the Grand Canyon.

Title: 66. Sunburn
description: After a rich old man dies in a suspicious car accident in Acapulco, Mexico, his widow wants his insurance company to pony up five million dollars. Hotshot investigator Jake Decker (Charles Grodin) and charming model Ellie (Farrah Fawcett-Majors) come in to check it out.

Title: 67. Rich Kids
description: Two 12-year-olds, the products of Upper-West-Side broken homes, struggle to make sense of their parents' lives and their own adolescent feelings.

Title: 68. Walk Proud
description: A young Chicano gang member in Los Angeles comes to realize that the gang life is not what he really wants but doesn't know how to get out.

Title: 69. Last Embrace
description: A government agent recovering from a nervous breakdown deciphers a death threat written in ancient Hebrew.

Title: 70. Goldengirl
description: A neo-Nazi doctor tries to make a superwoman of his daughter who has been specially fed, exercised, and conditioned since she was a child in preparation of the Olympics.

Title: 71. From Mao to Mozart: Isaac Stern in China
description: Isaac Stern's cultural tour of China is seen, with the master violinist performing and mentoring young Chinese musicians. He visits rehearsals of the Peking Opera, meeting with their musicians who use traditional Chinese instruments, and also visits a sports academy and other venues. The lingering effects of the Cultural Revolution (1966-1976), which opposed any western influences and oppressed those who introduced western approaches, are evident in the lack of skill development among many of the young musicians and the emphasis on technical skill rather than artistic interpretation.

Title: 72. Winter Kills
description: The younger brother of an assassinated US President is led down a rabbit hole of conspiracies and dead ends after learning of a man claiming to be the real shooter.

Title: 73. The Passage
description: During World War II, a Basque shepherd is approached by underground operatives who want him to lead a scientist and his family across the Pyrenees while they're being pursued by a sadistic German officer.

Title: 74. City on Fire
description: A pyromaniac, ex-employee of a city oil refinery creates an explosion at the facility which starts a chain-reaction of fires that engulf the entire city.

Title: 75. A Man, a Woman and a Bank
description: The two least likely bank robbers in the known universe plan and execute... kind of... the ultimate heist.

Title: 76. Beyond the Reef
description: Tikoyo lives by the Bora Bora lagoon in the South Pacific, where he found a man-eating tiger shark when it was an orphaned baby, just a foot long. He named it Manidu, and it grew to be sixteen feet long. Tikoyo believes that his companion houses the soul of a wise old man, and helps him guard the sacred black pearls in the lagoon. In fact, Manidu does protect Tikoyo and his girlfriend Diana, only eating those who are their enemies, or who seek to destroy their environment, or steal the pearls.

Title: 77. Fast Charlie... the Moonbeam Rider
description: A World War I deserter competes in the first long-distance motorcycle race.

Title: 78. The Human Factor
description: When a leak of information in the African section of British Intelligence is discovered, security man Daintry is brought in to investigate.

Title: 79. Real Life
description: A film crew sets out to record a year in the life of an average family, but things quickly start going wrong.

Title: 80. Stalker
description: A guide leads two men through an area known as the Zone to find a room that grants wishes.

Title: 81. Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
description: David Bowie performs as his alter ego Ziggy Stardust for the very last time at the Hammersmith Odeon, London on July 3, 1973.

Title: 82. Lupin III: The Castle of Cagliostro
description: A dashing thief, his gang of desperadoes and an intrepid cop struggle to free a princess from an evil count, and learn the secret of a treasure that she holds part of the key to.

Title: 83. Home Movies
description: Keith Gordon is a creative young man who films the oddball doings of his family and peers. "The Maestro" appears frequently to give him pointers on his techniques. It's almost a film about a young man making the film.

Title: 84. An Almost Perfect Affair
description: A smalltime US filmmaker goes to Cannes to try to get his movie in the limelight. A wife of one of the producers there gets interested in his story and they begin an affair.

Title: 85. Christ Stopped at Eboli
description: A doctor in Fascist Italy is exiled to a remote village for his political views.

Title: 86. Dread Beat and Blood
description: Follows dub poet master Linton Kwesi Johnson out of the recording studio onto the Brixton streets.

Title: 87. The Wanderers
description: The Wanderers is a teenage, Italian gang in Bronx, NYC, 1963. They have their confrontations with other gangs. Drugs and weapons are uncool. Adult life awaits them.

Title: 88. The Wobblies
description: Investigates a nation torn by naked corporate greed and the red-hot rift between the industrial masters and the rabble-rousing workers in the field and factory.

Title: 89. Vengeance Is Mine
description: Chronological exploits of Iwao Enokizu, a murderous thief on the run.

Title: 90. The Marriage of Maria Braun
description: Maria marries Hermann Braun in the last days of World War II, only for him to go missing in the war. Alone, Maria puts to use her beauty and ambition in order to find prosperity during Germany's "economic miracle" of the 1950s.

Title: 91. Legend of the Mountain
description: A scholar, tasked to copy a sutra, meets with a mysterious old lady and her daughter in the mountains.

Title: 92. Scum
description: An uncompromising story of life in a British juvenile offender institution in the '70s.

Title: 93. Serie Noire
description: Franck Poupart is a slightly neurotic door-to-door salesman in a sinister part of Paris' suburbs. He meets Mona, a teenager, who's been made a prostitute by her own aunt. Franck would like to change his life and also save Mona from her aunt. Murder is the only solution he finds to achieve his goal... A very gloomy movie, exuding despair and uneasiness, with pathetic characters.

Title: 94. Love on the Run
description: Antoine Doinel is now more than thirty. He divorces from Christine. He is a proofreader, and is in love with Sabine, a record seller. Colette, his teenage love, is now a lawyer. She buys Antoine's first published autobiographical novel. They meet again in a station.

Title: 95. Caligula
description: A dramatization of the ascent to Caesar and subsequent reign of Caligula, one of the most notorious leaders of ancient Rome.

Title: 96. The Brood
description: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalized wife, amidst a series of brutal murders.

Title: 97. The Tin Drum
description: In 1924, Oskar Matzerath is born in the Free City of Danzig. At age three, he falls down a flight of stairs and stops growing. In 1939, World War II breaks out.

Title: 98. Nosferatu the Vampyre
description: Count Dracula moves from Transylvania to Wismar, spreading the Black Plague across the land. Only a woman pure of heart can bring an end to his reign of horror.

Title: 99. Hardcore
description: A religious businessman from Michigan has to venture into the world of pornography in California, desperately searching for his runaway teenage daughter.

Title: 100. Quadrophenia
description: Jimmy Cooper loathes his dead-end job and his working-class parents. He seeks solace with his mod clique, scooter riding, and drugs, only to be disappointed.

Title: 101. Time After Time
description: H.G. Wells pursues Jack the Ripper to the 20th Century when the serial murderer uses the future writer's time machine to escape his time period.

Title: 102. Tourist Trap
description: A group of young friends stranded at a secluded roadside museum are stalked by a masked assailant who uses his telekinetic powers to control the attraction's mannequins.

Title: 103. The In-Laws
description: On the eve of their children's marriage, NYC in-laws Sheldon Kornpett and Vince Ricardo embark on a series of misadventures involving the CIA, the Treasury Department and Central American dictators.

Title: 104. My Brilliant Career
description: A proud young woman in early 20th century Australia must choose between marriage and independence.

Title: 105. Wise Blood
description: Fresh out of the army, Hazel Motes attempts to open the first Church Without Christ in the small town of Taulkinham.

Title: 106. Laura
description: Sculptor Paul is reunited with a former great love after a long time, but is much more impressed by his 15-year-old daughter, Laura, who looks like her mother when Paul was in love with her.

Title: 107. Over the Edge
description: A group of bored teenagers rebel against authority in the community of New Granada after the death of one of their own.

Title: 108. The Man Who Stole the Sun
description: A high school science teacher builds an atomic bomb and uses it to extort the nation, but cannot decide what he wants. Meanwhile, a determined cop is catching up to him, as is radiation poisoning.

Title: 109. The Silent Scream
description: During her first semester at college, a co-ed finds housing at a seaside mansion where, following the death of a fellow-student, she becomes entangled in a murder mystery surrounding the property and its secretive tenants.

Title: 110. The Driller Killer
description: An artist slowly goes insane while struggling to pay his bills, work on his paintings, and care for his two female roommates, which leads him taking to the streets of New York after dark and randomly killing derelicts with a power drill.

Title: 111. Gol Maal
description: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates into more complex lies when his orthodox boss gets suspicious.

Title: 112. The Gendarme and the Extra-Terrestrials
description: In St. Tropez, French gendarme Cruchot and his men battle petroleum-drinking, human-looking, metallic aliens.

Title: 113. Zombie
description: Strangers searching for a young woman's missing father arrive at a tropical island where a doctor desperately seeks the cause and cure of a recent epidemic of the undead.

Title: 114. The Villain
description: Facing hanging, a bank robber makes a deal with the corrupt banker to avoid execution in exchange for a dirty assignment.

Title: 115. Luna
description: A widowed American opera singer relocates to Rome with her teenage son, only to discover his severe heroin addiction, a crisis that drives her to commit drastic and transgressive acts in a desperate bid to save him.

Title: 116. Camera Buff
description: An ordinary factory worker buys a camera on the occasion of the birth of his child. The authorities order him to make documentaries about the factory's success, but his endeavor to be truthful leads him to opposition against censorship.

Title: 117. The Bugs Bunny/Road-Runner Movie
description: Bugs Bunny reflects on his past cartoon exploits.

Title: 118. ...And Give Us Our Daily Sex
description: Two alluring nurses catch the attention of a young inventor with his homemade periscope, while his mother pursues secret affairs during her husband's frequent salon visits.

Title: 119. Saint Jack
description: Jack Flowers, an American hustler in early-1970s Singapore, dreams of building a fortune by running a brothel and returning to the States to live a life of luxury.

Title: 120. I... For Icarus
description: Conspiracy thriller inspired by the conspiracy theories surrounding the assassination of JFK. After a fictional president is assassinated, a determined, tough prosecutor investigates the emerging conspiracy behind it.

Title: 121. Nightwing
description: Killer bats plague an Indian reservation in New Mexico.

Title: 122. Fascination
description: A desperate thief hides from vengeful pursuers in an isolated estate, only to fall into the clutches of aristocratic women whose hunger for blood matches their insatiable sexual appetites.

Title: 123. Hot Stuff
description: Miami police fence stolen goods at a storefront-sting operation equipped with a two-way mirror.

Title: 124. Skatetown U.S.A.
description: At a roller-disco competition, two rivals find themselves becoming good friends while competing for a prize of $1000 in cash.

Title: 125. The Day Time Ended
description: Aliens visit the solar-powered house of a middle-class family, and the house is suddenly sucked into a time warp that transports it back to prehistoric times.

Title: 126. Chilly Scenes of Winter
description: Charles, a bored civil servant struggling through a harsh Utah winter, spends most of his time reflecting on his romance with Laura, a coworker who left him to return to her husband, an A-Frame salesman.

Title: 127. The Lady in Red
description: After being in the wrong place at the wrong time, a naïve farm girl moves to Chicago, where she becomes trapped in a vicious cycle of prostitution and crime abetted by John Dillinger.

Title: 128. Woyzeck
description: Franz Woyzeck is a hapless, hopeless soldier; alone and powerless in society, assaulted from all sides by forces he cannot control.

Title: 129. French Fried Vacation 2
description: Eight tourists who met in a holiday camp on the Ivory Coast are reunited for a skiing holiday.

Title: 130. Kummatty
description: A magician who entertains children temporarily transforms his young spectators of a village into animals. However, a boy transformed into a dog misses the moment to break the spell and has to wait for the magician to return.

Title: 131. Rock 'n' Roll High School
description: Ramones fanatic and delinquent Riff Randell battles it out with the strict new principal of Vince Lombardi High School, Miss Togar, with help from the Ramones.

Title: 132. The Adolescent
description: In 1939, a 13-year-old girl develops a crush on the town's Jewish doctor while visiting her grandmother. Her parents have an affair with the doctor. When her father returns, tensions arise regarding the relationships and the impending war.

Title: 133. Mimi
description: Maria visits her paralyzed widower father Guido at a hotel. She tries seducing him. Her friend Therese arrives, and Guido starts an affair with her, leading to tragic consequences. Objective plot points without opinions or introduction.

Title: 134. Murder by Decree
description: Sherlock Holmes investigates the murders commited by Jack the Ripper and discovers a conspiracy to protect the killer.

Title: 135. The Visitor
description: The soul of a young girl with telekinetic powers and her mother become the prize in a battle between good ETs and evil ETs.

Title: 136. Don't Go in the House
description: Traumatized loner Donald Kohler struggles after his mother's death, as childhood abuse, obsessive thoughts, and a growing fixation with fire push him toward increasingly dangerous encounters with unsuspecting women.

Title: 137. Malibu High
description: After being dumped by her boyfriend and about to flunk high school, Kim decides on major changes by using her body.

Title: 138. Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: An extension of the previous film, wherein a group of adventurers return to the overturned ship to seek several fortunes.

Title: 139. Zulu Dawn
description: A dramatization of the Battle of Isandlwana, where the British Army met its match against the Zulu nation.

Title: 140. Escape to Athena
description: A World War II adventure involving a group of Allied P.O.W.s, Nazis, black market priceless art treasures, Greek resistance, a Greek monastery, and a secret German rocket base.

Title: 141. Buffet Froid
description: Alphonse lives in an empty building. Empty but for one neighbour, the police captain Morvandieu. When the man who has killed Alphonse's wife appears, the three men will be thrown in a series of events in a surrealist world.

Title: 142. Good Luck, Miss Wyckoff
description: An abusive sexual relationship between a white spinster schoolteacher and a young black janitor in 1956 Kansas complicates her struggle to come to grips with her sexuality and emotions.

Title: 143. I'm for the Hippopotamus
description: In Africa, 2 expat "brothers" are usually at each other's throats but now have a common enemy. Ormond's men are shooting or catching much of the wildlife for export as well as forcing the locals off their land. Lots of fun fights follow.

Title: 144. Galaxy Express 999
description: The adventures of a brave young boy who travels from planet to planet in a determined quest to avenge his mother's death.

Title: 145. Fast Company
description: After his sponsor replaces him with his arch rival, a race-car driver decides to steal the car and race it himself.

Title: 146. Play Motel
description: A reporter and his girlfriend investigate deaths surrounding a hotel where several prominent people go to have sex.

Title: 147. Squeeze Play
description: A male softball team is challenged by a female softball team to see who is best.

Title: 148. Dead Mountaineer's Hotel
description: Police gets a call-out to a lonely hotel in the Alps. When an officer gets to the hotel everything seems to be all right. Suddenly, an avalanche cuts them out from the rest of the world, and strange things are going to happen.

Title: 149. Fearless Coward
description: Mulayim sert believes that he only has 6 month to live. So to avoid meeting his fate, he decides to re do his job status, carry a time bomb, and play Russian Roulette.

Title: 150. Alexandria... Why?
description: Yehia is a young man living in the cosmopolitan Alexandria during World War II. Inspired by American movies and Shakespeare, he aspires to be an actor, but struggles to pursue his Hollywood dream, given the constraints of his life in the middle class and the horrors of war.

Title: 151. Racquet
description: Centred around a former tennis champ who swings with the girls and volleying straight sets with the rich and famous while set on owning his own tennis court.

Title: 152. The Butterfly Murders
description: A journalist attempting to solve a mystery in "Martial World" enlists the aid of a master fighter and a woman named Green Breeze. They go to a mysterious castle where they come across poisonous butterflies and a black-leather-clad killer.

Title: 153. Don Giovanni
description: Mozart's opera in lush sets: Don Giovanni, the infamous womanizer, kills Donna Anna's father. He is then chased by Donna Anna's fiancé, Don Ottavio, as well as Donna Elvira, one of his former conquests. But the real threat lies elsewhere.

Title: 154. The Third Generation
description: A wildly anarchic satire of urban guerrilla warfare in which a band of leftist radicals inadvertently become puppets of the West German government, which uses them to justify its authoritarian policies.

Title: 155. Ballad of Tara
description: Tara, the young beautiful widow, returns with her two little kids from country to her village. In her way home, she finds out that her grandfather has passed away. She distributes grandpa's belongings among her neighbours. But there remains an old sword that no one accepts. One day on the road, she meets an old-time warrior. He claims that his clan have sent him to present time to take the old sword back. Tara finally submits the sword to him, but he comes back saying that he has fallen in love with her.

Title: 156. National Class Category Up to 785 Ccm
description: "Floyd," a rally driver in Belgrade, forgoes his relationship and military duties to solely train for a career-defining Saturday race with the potential to advance his aspirations.

Title: 157. Hunter in the Dark
description: An aging Yakuza boss in the the late 18th century runs a thriving lantern and silk dying business. However, he is also a Hunter in the Dark, an shady underworld figure who unravels a mystery about a rival clan. His wife tries to protect what he wants to throw away. His new bodyguard has a missing memory. The truth lies within the code of the Yakuza, where honor and sacrifice are rewarded with a warriors death.

Title: 158. Year Zero: The Silent Death of Cambodia
description: Disturbing documentary, shot on site less than a year after the Khmer Rouge downfall, depicting the shocking situation and recent history of Cambodia.

Title: 159. Beneath the Valley of the Ultra-Vixens
description: A glimpse into the sexual goings-on of the wacky denizens of Small Town, USA, including a couple whose otherwise perfect relationship is hampered by the husband's obsession with buggery.

Title: 160. Ashanti
description: Dr. Anansa Linderby (Beverly Johnson) is kidnapped in a medical mission in Africa by a slave trader. From this moment, her husband will do anything to recover her and to punish the bad guys, but that will be not an easy task.

Title: 161. Gas Pump Girls
description: New high-school graduates June and her friends take over a dilapidated service station owned by her bed-ridden uncle and must perform every trick in the book to compete against the modern station across the street.

Title: 162. Images in a Convent

description: The wife of a famous anthropologist is rushed to hospital in labor. At the same time, druggies raid the hospital looking for drugs, causing the baby to be stillborn. While recovering from the trauma, she learns that her husband has disappeared in Africa. She launches an expedition to find him, and discovers a bizarre world of sexy jungle women!

Title: 304. Midnight Dolls
description: Two friends escape from the mafia and dress up as women in a cabaret.

Title: 305. Uncle Marin: The Billionaire
description: A Romanian peasant, visiting a friend who is working at a hotel on the Black Sea Riviera, is mistaken for a look-alike rich American businessman.

Title: 306. Ticket of No Return
description: A woman presented as a "trinkerin" is having a special tour in Berlin. She bought herself a single-way ticket and will drink everywhere she can.

Title: 307. French Postcards
description: The believable, fresh-faced characters are naive American college students; armed with their French-English dictionaries they compulsively seek out hundreds of monuments, romanticize the nomadic artist's life, and look for grown-up love.

Title: 308. Family Nest
description: The breakdown of the relationship of a couple by living in a flat of the husband's parents.

Title: 309. The Evictors
description: A nice young couple move into an eerie house which is located in a small Louisiana town, unaware of its violent history, and soon find themselves tormented by the previous owners.

Title: 310. Angel Guts: Nami
description:
This is the third film in the Angel Guts series. It tells the story of Nami, a young female journalist. As she investigates the brutal stories of rape victims, she finds herself becoming more and more obsessed with the horror of their attacks. This obsession ultimately takes her down her own irreversible path of violence.

by IrishLass240 from Long Island, New York, USA

Title: 311. Don't Go Near the Park
description: Two siblings cursed in prehistoric times survive for millennia by feasting on the entrails of young people, prowling in what eventually becomes a park in contemporary Los Angeles.

Title: 312. Lobster for Breakfast
description: Marco is married to Carla, a rich businesswoman. She's off to Geneva for two days; he has a tryst with Monique, a Swedish air hostess. Carla's flight is canceled, so she heads home about to catch Mario en flagrant. Mario's salvation is Enrico, an old school mate and hapless salesman who shows up to beg Mario to buy toilets so he won't lose his job. Mario signs an order in exchange for Enrico's posing as Monique's husband. Carla invites them to stay overnight and join a business dinner party catered by Enrico's wife, Matilde. Enrico spends the evening trying to avoid her, Mario spends it chasing the willing Monique, and Carla wants to close a deal. Can this farce end happily?

Title: 313. Punk Rock
description: Filmed on location at New York's legendary underground clubs such as Max's Kansas City and featuring original music and appearances from bands THE STILLETTOS, THE SQUIRRELS, SPICY BITS and THE FAST! On the track of a teenage runaway, a trail of murder, sex, and drugs leads private eye Jimmy into the decadent New York City night world: from massage parlors to penthouses and after-hours nightclubs; from sex slavers and pimps to the dangerous members of a killer rock'n'roll band!

Title: 314. Erotica
description: Two man commit a robbery. One is caught and the other runaway. He ends his escape in a lonely and deserted beach when he meets a beautiful woman named Erotica. They both start a passionate love affair that is interrupted when the other conman escape from prison and joins them. A sexual/sentimental love triangle begins leading to a violent confrontation between the two men.

Title: 315. Annie Batungbakal
description: A musical comedy about Annie Batungbakal (Nora Aunor), who has a day job as a dispatcher, but at the end of the day she dances her way to the disco bars in glaring dance outfits. The film's official theme song of the same title performed by The Hotdogs tells it all.

Title: 316. Delirium
description: An ex-soldier is hired by local right-wingers as a vigilante to clean up criminals and street people, but he freaks out and starts killing off everybody.

Title: 317. Richard Pryor: Live in Concert
description: Richard Pryor's classic 1979 concert film has him discussing a wide range of topics, including race, the police and his favorite target -- himself.

Title: 318. Mission Galactica: The Cylon Attack
description: Running low on fuel, the Battlestar Galactica receives the help of the supposedly lost Battlestar Pegasus which is taking the offensive with the Cylons.

Title: 319. Dirty Ho
description: The eleventh son of the Qing emperor, who's a kung fu master, is visiting Canton incognito. While there, he meets a loudmouth thief who he takes under his wing, while assassins sent by his fourth brother threaten his life.

Title: 320. The World Is Full of Married Men
description: David Cooper works in advertising but spends more time on his love life despite the fact that he is married. When his wife Linda discovers his girlfriends, she decides to find get revenge by having an affair.

Title: 321. Isyan
description: In 1970s, in a rural province of Turkey, a beautiful young girl is forced to get married with son of the richest man in the village though she loves another young villager. Family's poverty and father's insistence lead young girl to accept the marriage. The marriage starts conflictions of customary law, moral values and class relations.

Title: 322. Perros callejeros II
description: A veteran policeman named Fernando feels a lot of hatred against Ángel because the boy ran him over with a car leaving him lame. Now Fernando accuses the young crook of having participated in a robbery at a gas station in which a murder has occurred. Helped by his friends, Ángel rebuilds the facts that serve him as an alibi, but while he is in pre-trial detention in La Modelo prison (Barcelona) a terrible mutiny will take place.

Title: 323. World of the Drunken Master
description: The brother of a winery owner, who's a drunken Kung Fu master, trains two young thieves in the art of the drunken kung fu after he catches them stealing from his brother's winery.

Title: 324. Osobykh primet net
description: 1902-1905. Felix Dzerzhinsky, exiled to Siberia, starts a riot at one of the transit points and flees to Warsaw with several comrades, where the gendarmes unsuccessfully search for him. They manage to capture him only during one of the demonstrations.

Title: 325. The Quatermass Conclusion
description: A separate screenplay by Nigel Kneale for theaters, parallel to the 1979 Quatermass 4-part miniseries. The story, set in the near future, involves influences from outer space that are possessing people. Professor Quatermass must save his granddaughter from the clutches of a popular, sinister cult called "Planet People" that "performs raptures."

Title: 326. Life Is Beautiful
description: Antonio is a retired aviator from the Portuguese colonial wars. He falls in love with a member of the resistance against the dictatorship of Antonio d'Oliveira Salazar. He is arrested and escapes with his love. The code word among the resisters is: 'Life is Beautiful.'

Title: 327. Radio On
description: In 1970s Britain, a man drives from London to Bristol to investigate his brother's death, and the purpose of his trip is offset by his encounters with a series of odd people.

Title: 328. Hurricane
description: The desperate love affair between a young Samoan chief and an American painter, against the will of her father. Amid this man-made tension comes a hurricane so devastating, the lives of the lovers and the entire island are imperiled.

Title: 329. Last Hurrah for Chivalry
description: A son tries to avenge his father, and gets two sword fighters to help him.

Title: 330. Concorde Affaire '79
description: A reporter tries to stop the crash of an aircraft after uncovering an airline's plot to save their business by sabotaging Concorde flights and have them decommissioned.

Title: 331. The Odd Angry Shot
description: In between drinking cans of Fosters beer, Australian soldiers tread on a few landmines, and generally experience the war in Vietnam.

Title: 332. Sabato, domenica e venerdì
description: Three episodes: an accountant marries a beautiful Japanese and follows her to Tokyo; a young man marries a Sicilian girl to save her from paternal wrath; a theatrical impresario marries her dancer so she can leave her place in the ballet.

Title: 333. El chanfle
description: The life of an untalented, but extremely kind waterboy who works for a Mexican soccer team, and how his life unexpectedly changed, when his wife fell pregnant.

Title: 334. Supersonic Man
description: The superhero Kronos, from a distant galaxy, tangles with the mad scientist Dr. Gulik over the fate of mankind.

Title: 335. Tigers in Lipstick
description: An Italian comedy about a heist involving a princess's necklace and a cast of characters who are not what they seem. They do about anything they can to get the necklace from one another.

Title: 336. Womanlight
description: Two strangers help each other survive a night of great loss.

Title: 337. Bog
description: Dynamite fishing in a rural swamp revives a prehistoric gill monster that must have the blood of human females in order to survive.

Title: 338. When You Comin' Back, Red Ryder?
description: Teddy, a troubled Vietnam veteran, has his car break down near a Texas roadside diner. He goes inside and subjects the diners to physical and mental torture.

Title: 339. The Magnificent Butcher
description: A hot headed young butcher, who is also a kung fu disciple, gets embroiled in a feud with a rival shaolin temple.

Title: 340. Que Viva Mexico
description: Eisenstein shows us Mexico in this movie, its history and its culture. He believes, that Mexico can become a modern state.

Title: 341. Dracula Blows His Cool
description: A descendant of the famous vampire gets a job as a photographer shooting beautiful fashion models at the family estate. Being around so much naked and semi-naked flesh has the expected effect on him.

Title: 342. Vlad Tepes
description: Vlad Tepes, otherwise known as Vlad the Impaler and Dracula, fights the Ottoman Turks on the battlefield and the Hungarian Boyars in his court.

Title: 343. Ravagers
description: In a post-apocalyptic world divided between two groups called the Flockers and the Ravagers, an adventurer and his "pleasure girl" try to find their way to a rumored safe haven called the Land of Genesis.

Title: 344. Doomed Love
description: In the eighteenth century the thwarted love affair between a young man from a good family and his 15-year-old neighbor. But the young lovers' families are fiercely opposed.

Title: 345. Going Steady
description: Teenage romance, parties and sex in 1950s Tel Aviv. Music is at the core of the lives of these teenagers. This is a comedy about three friends.

Title: 346. Canikom
description: Fikret, who wants to get away from his tiring business life, goes to Sile with his yacht for vacation. Here, Fikret's path crosses with Bahar.

Title: 347. West Indies
description: This vast musical fresco covers hundreds of years of history from enslavement to 20th-century immigration. Set on an enormous slave ship and boasts a dazzling array of brilliant choreography, wide-ranging musical styles and sharp satire.

Title: 348. The Runner Stumbles
description: A priest in a poor mining town struggles with his "controversial" work while dealing with his impoverished parish, difficult nuns at the local convent, and personal doubts

Title: 349. Autumn Marathon
description: Middle-aged university professor desperately tries to strike a balance in his life between his wife and his mistress, slowly getting bogged down in his own lies.

Title: 350. L'anello matrimoniale
description: After eight years of marriage with the brilliant cosmetic surgeon Mario, Monica starts an affair with their new neighbor Giorgio, a former swimming champion. After her passion subsides, Monica, who has always confided everything to Mario, returns home. Giorgio, who chose to hide everything from his wife Alma, will not save his marriage from this shipwreck no matter how skilled of a swimmer he is.

Title: 351. Klondike Fever
description: This movie chronicled Jack London's epic journey from San Francisco to the Klondike gold fields in 1898.

Title: 352. Twice a Woman
description: When a museum directer, who has long been divorced, takes a young girl as a lover things quickly become more complicated when her ex-husband also engages in a relationship with the girl.

Title: 353. The Maids of Wilko
description: Wictor moves in with his uncle in the countryside. He visits the nearby Wilko estate. Fifteen years earlier, he had spent a wonderful holiday there with the six sisters who lived there.

Title: 354. Meetings with Remarkable Men
description: G.I. Gurdjieff is a spiritual teacher and mystic who, after a lifetime study, developed a form of meditation incorporating modern dance.

Title: 355. Wolf Lake
description: War veterans visit a lakeside cabin for a week of shooting, drinking, etc. but find the cabin being looked after by a young caretaker named David. When David's status as a war deserter is revealed, all hell breaks loose.

Title: 356. A Life of Sin
description: Pablo, a Caribbean peasant and Isabel, a politician's mistress, open a brothel that becomes internationally famous. Though they gain wealth and power, the one thing that Isabel seeks continues to elude her. In HD.

Title: 357. The Outsider
description: A young American man joins the IRA in Ireland but soon finds out that he is being used for political purposes and propaganda.

Title: 358. Hell
description: Hell manifests itself through the sins, shame and desires of an upper class rural family and a mother's grief from beyond the grave.

Title: 359. Zoom Up: Murder Site
description: A young couple, meeting for a tryst at the site of a brutal rape/murder, witness another murder and have to decide whether to turn the killer in.

Title: 360. Undercover Lover
description: A British secret agent sent to America to rescue a nobleman comes up against an evil genius who is replacing people in important positions with clones who will do his bidding.

Title: 361. The Battle of Chile: Part III
description: This film investigates the factory worker's response to the insurrection, as well as Chile's socialist aspirations for the future. The camera captures the optimism in the industrial working class before Pinochet's US-backed coup d'état.

Title: 362. Noorie
description: NOORIE tells a simple and touching story of Noorie and Yusuf's fearless love and dream at all cost.

Title: 363. Game for Vultures
description: The South African businessman David Swansey (Richard Harris) is delivering illegal German helicopters to Rhodesia. That makes patriot Gideon Marunga (Richard Roundtree) an angry man.

Title: 364. The Tehran Incident
description: An American intelligence agent travels to pre-Islamic Revolution Iran to try to thwart a power-mad European baron from using a stolen cruise missile to destroy an unspecific target in that country.

Title: 365. Midnight Blue
description: Three female Olympians find their beach house invaded by three male escaped convicts. But the women's athletic abilities are their ace in the hole.

Title: 366. Derek and Clive Get the Horn
description: Documentary that chronicles the recording of Peter Cook and Dudley Moore's 1978 comedy album Derek and Clive Ad Nauseam, their third and final outing featuring their controversial alter egos.

Title: 367. The Great Gambler
description: An unrivaled gambler unknowingly aids a criminal syndicate in stealing military secrets. To stop him, Govt. deploys a lookalike inspector, sparking a chaotic international pursuit through Rome involving high stakes and mistaken lovers.

Title: 368. Savage Hunt of King Stakh
description: A mystical drama based on a story by V. Korotkevich. The film is set in out-of-the-way Belarusian woodlands at the end of the 19th century. A young ethnographer, Andrej Bielarecki, comes here to research local folk legends.

Title: 369. Atrocious Tales of Love and Death
description: A mandolin professor, reduced to playing the itinerant player, sees his feeble gains wasted at the game by his father.

Title: 371. Fyre
description: After an innocent country girl is violently raped, her family is killed in a car accident before she can come to terms with what happened. As her feelings of shame grow into self-degradation, she turns to prostitution.

Title: 372. The Return of Superman
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of Superman (1978)

Title: 373. The Little Dragons
description: A grandfather takes his two young grandsons on a camping trip for their karate tournament, and become involved in a kidnapping by a poor country family that lives in the woods.

Title: 374. Mr. Natwarlal
description: Natwar is just a young boy when his beloved older brother and caretaker, police officer Gridharilal (Ajit), is framed for bribery by sinister criminal mastermind Vikram (Amjad Khan). When he grows up, Natwar (Amitabh Bachchan) creates a secret identity for himself, posing as a powerful and mysterious underworld figure named Mr. Natwarlal, determined to slowly but surely exact vengeance on Vikram.

Title: 375. Arabian Adventure
description: An evil magician seeks to gain power by obtaining a magic rose. A peasant boy and a Prince join forces to stop him.

Title: 376. The Dogs
description: After several inhabitants of a new city were bitten by dogs, a young doctor tries to stop to the climb of violence.

Title: 377. Duos sur canapé
description: Bernard, a lawyer, and Jacqueline, a dentist, married for many years, each have their own home office. This becomes problematic when they decide to divorce and neither of them wants to move their practice.

Title: 378. Suhaag
description: Two brothers gets separated at the time of their birth. But when they reunite as adults, challenges welcome them.

Title: 379. Take Down
description: An unqualified teacher finds himself saddled with coaching duties after a small group of high school seniors form a wrestling team in a last ditch effort to end a 9-year losing streak against a rival school.

Title: 380. Jaguar
description: Poldo, a poor man, takes up a job as a security guard at a high-class apartment complex. However, he soon finds himself protecting his employer's son from the violent attacks of a nightclub owner.

Title: 381. Nightmares
description: The life and times of a sensitive, poetic Polish boy who watches his country strive towards the liberation movement.

Title: 382. Mama Turns 100
description: Ana is alive and married with Antonio; they arrive in the manor in the countryside of Spain where she worked as a nanny many years ago, for the centennial birthday of the matriarch. In their reunion, she finds that Jose died three years ago; Juan left his wife Luchy; Fernando is still living with his mother and unsuccessfully trying to fly a hang glider; and the three little girls are grown-up. Further, she discovers that the dysfunctional family is completely broken, and Luchy in embezzling mother's money. When Juan arrives for the celebration, he plots with Fernando and Luchy to kill the mother to get the inheritance. Meanwhile, Antonio has a brief affair with Natalia.

Title: 383. The American Success Company
description: Harry, who married his boss Mr. Elliott's daughter Sarah, has had enough of being humiliated both at home and at work. He hires prostitute Corinne to help him get back at his boss, wife, and friends and gets richer in the process.

Title: 384. Manaos
description: At the beginning of this century some owners of rubber plantations in the Amazonas jungle convert a village into one big prison. But the inhabitants have other plans...

Title: 385. Black Jack
description: When honest young Tolly is forced on the run with 'Black Jack,' adventure and mishap are never far away. Based on Leon Garfield's popular novel, Ken Loach's 'Black Jack' is a dark, complex adventure film set in the 18th century.

Title: 386. Jovana Lukina
description: Jovana, a beautiful woman, resides with her husband in a mountainous and rocky region. A road adjacent to your home is traveled by travelers with diverse destinations.

Title: 387. Natural Enemies
description: A man plots to kill his wife and children, seeking advice by disguising his plan as a fictional story for his business.

Title: 388. Die Hamburger Krankheit
description: The BRD is haunted by a mysterious, deadly plague. In Hamburg, a group of people head for an odyssey through the country to search for survivors and a rescue.

Title: 389. Day of the Assassin
description: Treasure hunters from around the world race to Mexico after a Middle Eastern luxury yacht explodes, sending a Shah's fortune and a mysterious document to the bottom of the ocean.

Title: 390. Screams of a Winter Night
description: An anthology in which a group of college coeds spending a winter's night in a remote cabin pass time by telling scary stories to each other.

Title: 391. Swim Team
description: A new swimming coach is hired to break a team's seven-year losing streak.

Title: 392. Can You Be with 5 Girls at Once?
description: Five women live with the memory of the man who made them happy.

Title: 393. Maa Bhoomi
description: The film depicts a typical life of villagers under feudalistic society in Telangana region. The film follows the story of a young landless Telangana peasant named Ramaiah (Sai Chand) from Siripuram, Nalgonda, a region under foreign rule. Ramaiah Rebels against the corrupt Nizam leadership in Hyderabad. When his wife has to submit to sexual coercion by the officials, he befriends the Communists and participates in the independence struggle.

Title: 394. Raining in the Mountain
description: In Ming Dynasty China, the abbot of the San Pao Buddhist monastery must choose a successor. Among the high dignitaries invited, there are some who are after the priceless parchment kept in the temple: the Mahayana Sutras.

Title: 395. Birth of the Beatles
description: An account of The Beatles during the Hamburg years, their signing with Brian Epstein and their inevitable rise during the early sixties.

Title: 396. Christiana
description: Sequel to Pilgrim's Progress. Christiana decides to follow in her husband's footsteps and make a pilgrimage to the Celestial City with her children and a friend.

Title: 397. The Prize Fighter
description: A mobster tricks an ex-boxer and his manager to take part in a series of (fixed) fights as part of a scheme to get his hands on an old boxing gym.

Title: 398. Life Sentence
description: A former felon is blackmailed by a corrupt policeman and forced to commit a crime.

Title: 399. A Policewoman on the Porno Squad
description: The adventures of Gianna, a sexy police woman (E Fenech) who wants to help a child in the search of his mother, who has ended up in trouble. She has become a prostitute and is kept prisoner. Gianna will succeed and be honoured for her "skills" shown (...) in duty.

Title: 400. The Crippled Masters
description: Two Kung-Fu masters betray and cripple their partners, but they combine martial arts to seek revenge against their evil master.

Title: 401. Mad Monkey Kung Fu
description: A kung fu expert is tricked by a gangster into believing he has committed adultery, so his sister becomes a concubine, and his hands are damaged beyond repair. Years later, he teaches a street hustler Monkey Kung-Fu, and they take revenge.

Title: 402. The Hollywood Strangler Meets the Skid Row Slasher
description: Hollywood Strangler ("Johnathan Click") kills young models... Skid Row Slasher kills winos ... What will happen when they meet?

Title: 403. Queen of the Blues
description: A seedy striptease club in London's West End becomes the target for unpleasant crooks. The club's owners are blackmailed into paying out large wads of cash, but star attraction Mary Millington saves the day with her energetic stripping.

Title: 404. Crocodile
description: A giant crocodile is killing and frightening people living nearby rivers. Two men, whose wives and daughter have been killed by the crocodile, decide to chase and eliminate it.

Title: 405. Knockabout
description: Two brothers and small time crooks Yipao and Taipao convince a martial arts expert to take them on as students, completely oblivious to his sordid past.

Title: 406. King Solomon's Treasure
description: Three adventurers lead an expedition into darkest Africa in search of the treasure of King Solomon, and on the way encounter hostile natives, volcanoes, dinosaurs and a lost Phoenician city ruled by a beautiful queen.

Title: 407. Joni
description: Based on Joni Eareckson's autobiography. She becomes paralyzed after breaking her neck in a swimming accident at age 17. Trying to cope with her new life, she learns to paint using her mouth and finds strength in her new Christian faith.

Title: 408. Do Shikari
description: Zorro kidnaps Sunita's father for ransom. She teams up with Ranjeet to find her brother and father's treasure in Africa, facing perils like wildlife, hostile tribes, deserts, betrayal, and greed during their adventure.

Title: 409. Hot Dogs on Ibiza
description: An Island of Fun, Sun and Stunning Bodies!

Title: 410. The Shark Hunter
description: A crusty recluse on a Caribbean island who is dedicated to destroying sharks gets involved in a hunt for buried treasure.

Title: 411. The Gambler
description: Dos amigos están enamorados de la misma mujer, y esto provoca peleas entre ellos.

Title: 412. The Kid with the Golden Arm
description: A criminal organization, headed by a kung fu master nicknamed the Golden Arm Kid, targets 200,000 gold taels being transported by a private security company, who's hired a few martial artists for protection, along with a drunkard sheriff.

Title: 413. The Mystery of Chess Boxing
description: A young orphan, Ah Pao wants to learn kung fu in order to avenge his father, who was killed by the infamous and terrifying Ghost Face Killer

Title: 414. Ups and Downs of a Super Stud
description: Germano is a well-endowed young man with innate sexual qualities: discovered by his father in intimate attitudes with the servant, he is sent to his grandmother, who runs a hotel in a seaside resort, actually a closed house called "Pensione Amore". He animates the grandmother's brothel, creating sensation and attracting considerable clientele, precisely because of his fame.

Title: 415. Ashram in Poona
description: A secretly filmed account of sessions at Osho Rajneesh's ashram in Pune, India.

Title: 417. The Capture of Bigfoot
description: A series of killings occur, with no suspects, the locals soon decide that Bigfoot is responsible.

Title: 418. Swap Meet
description: When a jealous rival damages his father's vintage car, Sigi races against time to raise $250 for repairs at a swap meet before dad returns home.

Title: 419. Nun's Diary: Confession
description: After being brutally raped, a young woman attempts to commit suicide. A priest talks her out of it and she decides to become a nun. Once inside the convent, she is again a victim of sexual abuse.

Title: 420. House of Seven Belles
description: The seven sisters of the outcast LeFleur family try to survive in a post-Civil War Deep South.

Title: 421. Snow White and Rose Red
description: Screen version of the fairy tale by the Brothers Grimm about two sisters - Schneeweißchen and Rosenrot, who with their love saved Princes Michael and Andreas from the evil spells of the Mountain Spirit

Title: 422. Gardenia il giustiziere della mala (Gardenia)
description: In the city of Rome lives Gardenia, a respected exponent of Roman organized crime.

Title: 423. Amar Deep
description: Raja was adopted by a criminal don (Ashok Kumar) at a very young age. After the death of the don, Raja inherits the property, and refrains from crime. However, the wealth and the power associated with it, make him arrogant. He desires Radha, the daughter of his servant, Ramu, and Raja asks his permission to marry her, Ramu accepts, but Radha refuses as she loves Kishan. Raja finds out that Radha is meeting with Kishan on the sly, and complains to Ramu, who forbids her from meeting with Kishan. Then Raja finds out a secret from Kishan's past, meets with him, hires him, and even arranges a lavish marriage for Kishan with Radha, resulting in Kishan being indebted to Raja. Raja entrusts him with more important and responsible work, which must get Kishan to travel a lot. Kishan eventually finds out the real reason for Raja's kindness. Was it that Raja wants Kishan out of the way so he can be near Radha, or is there another reason?

Title: 424. Uthiri Pookkal
description: A hedonist/sadist makes life hell for everyone around him.

Title: 425. Een vrouw tussen hond en wolf
description: In 1940 Antwerp, Lieve marries Adriaan, who joins German forces. She shelters resistance fighter François in 1942, finding true love. Post-war, she stays with convicted Adriaan despite loving François, but grows distant as François.

Title: 426. Ten Tigers of Kwangtung
description: The movie involves two stories concerning the original Ten Tigers and their future disciples.

Title: 427. Il malato immaginario
description: During the year 1673, Rome was besieged by poverty and violence. The rich Mr. Argante has two servants to look after him, while his wife is only waiting to see him dead to inherit.

Title: 428. Ashta Vinayak
description: A step mother feels neglected by her husband and her step son, later she turns into a cruel mother.

Title: 429. Baton Baton Mein
description: Nancy and Tony meet regularly on their daily commute to work and gradually fall in love. But when Tony shows reluctance toward marriage, Nancy's mother starts looking for a groom for her daughter.

Title: 430. Cocaine Cowboys
description: Dustin (Tom Sullivan) is the leader of a rock band on the brink of super-stardom. Until now they have juggled their music career with cocaine smuggling. The musicians, and their manager Raf (Jack Palance), wish to sever ties with organized-crime, leave the drug world behind and concentrate on music. However they are coerced into doing one last job for the Mob. They lose the $2 million of cocaine, and find themselves marked men unless they can fulfill their obligations.

Title: 431. Cola, Candy, Chocolate
description: After a nasty argument with her boyfriend Carl, young Gaby spontaneously accepts her girlfriend invitation to join her on a vacation to Manila. Her plans to forget about Carl succeed very rapidly as she meets Dr. Andreas Witzig, a young scholar who plans to marry his fiancee on the island. During the following days, Gaby tries her best to convince the man of her dreams to change his mind.

Title: 432. La hija de nadie
description: Since childhood, Yolanda and her twin sister Irene suffer from the fact that her father left them alone with their mother and took their older brother with him. As the mother raised them, Yolanda becomes a singer, and Irene finds love, but he turns out to be her older brother after her sick father reveals the truth.

Title: 433. Sins of a Nympho
description: A sex party at a movie producer's house ends with traumatic results for a young couple.

Title: 434. Scusi, lei è normale?
description: A moralistic judge declares war on pornography. His gay nephew, who lives with a transvestite, tries to save himself and also protect his friend Ana, a porn actress.

Title: 435. I viaggiatori della sera
description: A famous radio announcer is being retired at the top of his career and in full professional maturity. But for him and his wife life is not over now, he has more plans.

Title: 436. Las cariñosas
description: Juan Alonso is going through life not taking time to smell the flowers along the way. He stumbles onto a cabaret show and he falls.in love with the star. What he finds out later is that the lead dancer is really a Transexual and he is torn about his feelings about her. Stunningly gorgeous, this story really takes a lot of twists and turns. Kinda like thw mexican version of Victor Victoria, but in reverse!

Title: 437. Cat Prince
description: The castle custodian Král is moving to a new place of work with his wife, son Radek and a five - years old daughter Terezka. Radek takes his cat Líza with him. A fully loaded truck moves through the country which is in spring blossoms, gradually changing into a snow-covered land. Children's imagination creates from real experiences magic stories - a fairy-tale grandpa takes them to a new castle, the children fear a black-horse rider who - as the grandpa and the cleaning lady assert she hates cats.

Title: 438. Death Becomes Me
description: Two episodes of the TV series "The Persuaders" joined into a movie. Two playboys, Brett Sinclair (Roger Moore) and Danny Wilde (Tony Curtis), investigate crimes.

Title: 439. L'insegnante balla... con tutta la classe
description: Girls' dance instructor Claudia Gambetti takes over the boy's gym class after gym teacher Martorelli breaks both his legs owing to one of his student's pranks. Soon both teachers and students are interested in learning more of Claudia's athletic dance moves. Director Fiorontori has made some debts betting on horses and wants Claudia to win a disco competition to balance the school budget, too. When the boys team are invited to face off against their superior Russian counterparts, Claudia calls in her dancing girls to be used as a secret weapon.

Title: 440. Maula Jat
description: In rural Punjab, a lawman enters into a violent feud with a notorious local criminal.

Title: 441. Dr. Jekyll's Dungeon of Death
description: Dr. Henry Jekyll, the great-grandson and namesake of the original Dr. Henry Jekyll, kidnaps people and experiments on them using the potion created by his dead great-grandfather.

Title: 442. Promises in the Dark
description: Numbed by career demands and a recent divorce, Dr. Alexandra Kendall (Marsha Mason) hides behind a hard shell of professional detachment, until she treats Buffy Koenig (Kathleen Beller), a dying 17-year-old cancer patient who reawakens Kendall to life's possibilities. Soon the courageous girl's condition takes a downturn, and the physician must carefully, even agonizingly, weigh the consequences of keeping a promise she made to Buffy.

Title: 443. Silvia ama a Raquel
description: The plot centers on the sexual awakening and intimate bond that develops between two young women, Silvia and Raquel, as they navigate a highly restrictive and conservative social environment.

Title: 444. La patata bollente
description: A factory worker known for his tough attitude and for fighting for workers' rights starts losing credibility when friends and co-workers see him helping a young gay man.

Title: 445. Zum Gasthof der spritzigen Mädchen
description: In the countryside, somewhere in the Bavarian Nowhere. Kirchenwirt Alois is financially up to his neck. His restaurant runs extremely bad, and only the bailiff regularly looks at him.

Title: 446. To Kill a Mastermind
description: Undercover government agent infiltrates powerful crime syndicate threatening Chinese empire. Betrayals and infighting within gang unveil agent's identity. Climactic confrontation between agent and syndicate leader follows.

Title: 448. Jaguar Lives!
description: The world's new Karate hero (Joe Lewis) is out to stop drug dealers, gangs, and help save the world from an evil con (Sir Christopher Lee).

Title: 449. Partizanska eskadrila
description: The first Yugoslav Partisan air force unit. Loosely based on historical facts.

Title: 450. Convoi de filles
description: German officer Erich von Strasse fought somewhere in Africa, was wounded and returned to Berlin with the Iron Cross and the glory of the hero. After a little vacation, he had to go to the Russian front. Suddenly, a brothel in Berlin, he met Renata, girl he met before the start of his military career. Eric found out that her family hid in her house a Jew, for which his father went to prison, and Renata at the insistence of the Gestapo officer has signed a contract to enter into a kind of "woman's auxiliary unit" has turned into a brothel.

Title: 451. The Sadist of Notre Dame
description: An ex-priest escapes from an asylum and kills people in God's name. This is a re-edited Spanish-language version of L'éventreur de Notre-Dame (1975) and XXX version Sexorcismes (1975) with newly shot scenes.

Title: 452. Search and Destroy
description: The members of a Vietnam veteran's old Army unit start turning up murdered. The police soon begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer. He knows he isn't, and must find the real killer in order to clear his name. He soon realizes, however, that the real killer is now hunting him.

Title: 453. Dedicato al mare Egeo
description: Nikos, a broke art student living in a boarding house owned by the divorcee Elda, and the two promptly start an affair; while at it, though, Nikos also sleeps with two tourists which causes jealousy and tension in Elda's establishment.

Title: 454. El Super
description: Slice-of-life look at Roberto and Aurelia, Cuban exiles living in New York City with their 17-year-old daughter Aurelita. It's February, 1978; the winter is harsh, and for 10 years Roberto's been the super of an apartment building: firing up the boiler, repairing windows, moving bags of garbage. He's homesick for Cuba, stuck in repetitive conversations about the Bay of Pigs, Castro, and life back home. He's too depressed to make love to Aurelia, and when his daughter thinks she's pregnant and he receives sad news from Cuba, he makes up his mind to quit the city for Miami. The decision gives him new life, he remembers Aurelia's birthday, and they have a party to celebrate.

Title: 455. The Swap
description: Vinnie gets out of jail after serving 10 years and tries to find out who killed his younger brother - played by a young Robert de Niro.

Title: 456. Roots of Evil
description: German Karate teacher Frank Mertens battles the drug lord Van Bullock in the streets of Madrid.

Title: 457. Together?
description: A women is trying to change her life for the better, but everything and everyone in her life is giving her more headache than joy.

Title: 458. Tarka the Otter
description: A family movie which follows the life of a real otter and its adventures in the wild.

Title: 459. Liquirizia
description: Two groups of students - the third-class high school students and the matured accountants - decide to perform a show to celebrate the last day of school.

Title: 460. Tres mujeres en la hoguera
description: Alex, a real estate businessman, has no concerns in giving her wife every kind of freedom. They invite Gloria, an old friend of both, to spend the summer break in their countryside house next to the beach. Gloria doesn't come alone: she comes with young Susy, her lover. Alex will use all of his charms and luxury to manipulate his new guests; meanwhile, his wife and Gloria will gang up to murder him.

Title: 461. Where Can You Go Without the Little Vice?
description: A private investigator is hired by a seductive woman, who instructs her to find out if there are other women in her husband's life, a rich and powerful businessman.

Title: 462. Pilot Pirx's Inquest
description: Humanlike robots replace humans on space missions. Test flight with robots and human crew, including commander Pirx unaware of robots' identities, evaluates robot performance/interactions. UN organizes mission to assess robot capabilities.

Title: 464. Et la tendresse?... Bordel!
description: The role of tenderness in love is explained in this film through three couples namely a male chauvinist pig couple,a romantic couple and a tender couple.

Title: 466. Us Two
description: Simon Lacassaine a thief with cultural attachments has just broken out of jail. Through circumstances, he falls in with upmarket hooker Deneuve, also on the constabulary's wanted list, and between them they spend the better part of the movie evading both the Gendarmes and US Authorities.

Title: 467. She's 19 and Ready
description: A young woman, just turning 19, is ready for anything, including fullfilling her dreams and fantasies. But two young men, Klaus and Stephen, are after her with their raging hormones to lead the way. The young lady learns to grow up fast, though, when strange occurences and new people enter her life, including more and more men.

Title: 468. Bolo
description: Two convicts get freed from prison and become lawmen in a corrupt village.

Title: 469. To hamogelo tis Pythias
description: Four robbers attempt, between several misfortunes, to steal a famous statue from the museum of Delfi under the orders of a blackmailer.

Title: 470. Ahsaas
description: Sudarshan Sahni wants Raju to marry Rita, but Raju is in love with Anu. Anu's father, Pradeep Rai Choudhry, doesn't approve, so they elope, marry, and live in a remote village. Their parents return to their world.

Title: 471. Rust Never Sleeps
description: Documentary covering Neil Young's October 22, 1978 concert performance at the Cow Palace.

Title: 472. El sexo ataca (1ª jornada)
description: The Spanish version of Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask).

Title: 473. Wild Horse Hank
description: A teenage girl (Hank) tries to save a herd of wild horses from a local gang intending on capturing and selling them for dogmeat. Unfortunately the nearest Federal land where the horses will be safe lies one hundred and fifty miles away, over badlands and a mountain range. Based on the novel "The Wild Horse Killers".

Title: 474. The House of Hanging
description: Kosuke visits a photo studio to take photo for his passport. There he happens to meet a daughter who came to request a wedding anniversary photo shoot.

Title: 475. Junoon
description: Set during the 1857 War of Independence, an obsessed Indian Nawab desires to wed a young Anglo-Indian woman, but the girl's obstinate mother stands between them.

Title: 476. A Woman in the Night
description: Aldo Muratti, is a man, separated from his wife, who to pay for food and be able keep his daughter writes porn novels.

Title: 477. Snake in the Monkey's Shadow
description: The master of a drunken fist is killed by a deadly snake fist duo in a major battle, so his only student flees and becomes a covert, expert fighter.

Title: 478. The Medic
description: The story is set in June 1983. Famous surgeon Jean-Marie Desprée was left by his wife 1 month ago and now he works in a modern movable hospital, where the 3rd world war is taking place.

Title: 479. L'école est finie
description: Julien, fifteen-year-old, meets Nathalie, a girl his age whom he falls in love. Soon she is expecting a child. Their parents take the news with reservations. The baby will come and with it, the difficult learning of life.

Title: 480. Derya Gülü
description: The story of a young sailor who has a forbidden love affair with the wife of an old captain.

Title: 481. Org
description: Explores the complex relationship between the spirit, body, and mind. The film is a nightmare with closed eyes because it counts among the most terrible moments of my life, my second exile, which lasted a very long time. Inspired by an ancient Hindu legend.

Title: 482. Glowing Autumn
description: A very beautiful Japanese woman is in love with Persian carpets. She is being chased by lecherous Saburi Shin and a handsome young photographer. Lecherous Saburi Shin knows what she wants, and is able to produce it for her.

Title: 483. From Hell to Victory
description: In 1939, at a Paris café, six friends of various nationalities vow to meet again at the same spot after the end of WW2.

Title: 484. The Golden Lady
description: A wealthy industrialist hires Julia Hemingway and her elite team of three female mercenaries to sabotage a deal between his competitor and an oil sheik. They spy, seduce, steal and, when their employer tries to double-cross them, kill.

Title: 485. Plague
description: An ambitious lab assistant carries out a forbidden experiment and accidentally creates a deadly bacteria which kills her and rapidly engulfs the city. The authorities order a curtain of secrecy and impose quarantine on all known contacts whilst embarking on a desperate search for a cure. Meanwhile one of the people in quarantine escapes and becomes the unwitting carrier of the disease. She spreads the plague wherever she goes and becomes a fugitive on the run eluding the police through subways and alleyways. In a gripping build up of events, the full horror of the plague becomes public and the onslaught has to be stopped before all human life on Earth is destroyed.

Title: 486. Surakksha
description: In a bid to locate a missing employee, Jackson, the Central Bureau of Investigation assigns Agent Gopi to locate him. Gopi accepts this assignment and must battle women; venomous snakes; gangsters; kidnappers; a robot-human; as well as Priya Varma - who believes that he killed her father, Dr. Varma; Neelam - who is determined to seduce and then enslave him; and the unknown and mysterious head of an organization simply known as S.S.O..

Title: 487. Un om în loden
description: Threatening letters, phone calls in the middle of the night - Who is threatening engineer Stamatiad?

Title: 488. The House by the Edge of the Lake
